verdict.rationale: Steel's docs describe reusing auth context to keep authenticated state across multiple sessions, so agents can reach protected resources without logging in again each time. The docs homepage also lists "persistent profiles" as a core product feature, which covers the reusable-profile and skip-the-login-wall parts of the story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how profiles are created, stored and reloaded (cookies/localStorage/profile lifecycle), and independent or hands-on corroboration that persisted logins survive across runs.
